request: Rename Todo.done to Todo.completed everywhere, and make list hide completed todos by default (includeDone: true shows them).

requests.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
requests.reason: It expected list(todos) with no options to include the completed item ("[x] milk\n[ ] eggs"). That is the opposite of the new behaviour the instruction asks for, where completed todos are hidden by default. The no-options case now expects "[ ] eggs", and the full output is now checked with { includeDone: true }. The includeDone: false check is unchanged.

approvals.title: commands > lists, optionally hiding done items
